text: You get separated from your hiking group during a sudden mountain storm with only a half-charged phone and a box of matches.
While exploring an uncharted coastal cave during low tide, you realize the water has risen and cut off your exit route.
Your solo road trip through the desert comes to a sudden halt when your car engine breaks down twenty miles from the nearest town.
During a white-water rafting trip, your raft capsizes on a fierce rapid, separating you from your gear and leaving you stranded on an isolated riverbank.
You unlock your front door after a week away and discover an antique pocket watch ticking on your kitchen counter that does not belong to you.
While browsing an old secondhand bookshop, you find a handwritten letter slipped inside a novel detailing a secret hidden in your own neighborhood.
Every night at exactly 2:15 AM, your smart speaker turns on and whispers the coordinates to an abandoned warehouse across town.
You receive a sealed envelope in the mail containing a photograph of you taken yesterday in a place you thought you visited alone.
You wake up one morning to find that every electronic screen on Earth is counting down backward from twenty-four hours.
A prototype device you bought at a garage sale allows you to hear other people's unspoken thoughts, but only for ten seconds at a time.
You are the lone night operator at an automated weather outpost when a radio transmission arrives from a spacecraft that vanished fifty years ago.
In a future where people can back up and restore their daily memories, you wake up realizing your entire previous weekend has been deleted.
You accidentally send a venting message meant for your best friend to your company-wide announcement channel five minutes before an all-hands meeting.
You agree to pet-sit what you thought was a quiet domestic cat for the weekend, only to discover it has an obsession with stealing neighbors' shoes.
You attend a formal wedding as a plus-one, only to realize you showed up at the wrong venue and gave a toast to total strangers.
Your attempts to cook a fancy five-course dinner to impress your in-laws turn into a kitchen catastrophe when the smoke alarms trigger the fire sprinklers.
You find an unmarked envelope stuffed with thousands of dollars in cash on a subway bench right after watching someone who looked desperate leave the train.
You discover that your closest friend and business partner has secretly taken company credit for an idea created by an unpaid intern.
At a prestigious job interview, you are accidentally handed the answer key and evaluation rubric before the evaluation begins.
You learn a family secret that could clear a distant relative's tarnished reputation, but revealing it would expose an embarrassing mistake made by your parents.
A moment in your childhood when a simple mistake or misunderstanding taught you a lesson you still remember today.
A time when you took a spontaneous risk to travel somewhere completely unfamiliar, and things did not go at all as planned.
An unexpected conversation with a complete stranger that completely shifted how you viewed an important decision in your life.
A competition, performance, or public speaking event where everything that could go wrong did, and how you managed to pull through.
